complaints.title: UNBELIEVABLE! 5 hours late delivery for my sister's birthday present in Karachi!
complaints.description: I booked parcel CN-8820194819 via Express Overnight from Clifton to Gulshan-e-Iqbal. Your portal promised delivery by 1:00 PM! The party started at 5:00 PM and the rider showed up at 6:15 PM with a careless smirk on his face! My sister was crying because her gift wasn't opened during cake cutting! This is UNACCEPTABLE and utter incompetence! I demand you immediately refund my express delivery fee and fire that rider!

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Standard domestic transit delay under 24 hours without perishable contents
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Sentiment-urgency trap: Customer displays intense agitation and emotional distress over a 5-hour same-day transit delay which is a routine operational P2 issue.

complaints.title: Your rider didn't even wait 5 minutes while I was praying Asr prayer in Lahore!
complaints.description: I am beyond furious! Tracking CN-4491028371 shows 'Customer Unreachable'! The rider arrived at 4:35 PM in Gulberg III while the Asr prayer call was on. My phone was in the other room. By 4:40 PM when I stepped out, he had sped off on his bike! How dare he not wait 5 minutes?! Now tracking says next delivery attempt tomorrow! I want my parcel right this minute or I will personally come down to the Gulberg hub and cause an uproar!

complaints.title: Outer cardboard carton slightly squished at corner! This is TOTAL INCOMPETENCE!
complaints.description: I ordered a flagship Samsung smartphone under tracking CN-99401827401. Your delivery person handed over the package and the bottom-left corner of the brown outer shipping carton had a 2-inch crease! I opened the box in front of him and while the Samsung retail box and phone inside are completely mint and working perfectly, how can your hub handlers treat expensive shipments with such disrespect?! I pay premium rates! Replace the outer packaging and compensate me for emotional distress!

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Minor outer carton denting with internal goods completely undamaged

complaints.title: DAYLIGHT ROBBERY! Charged PKR 180 extra for volumetric weight on cushion pillows!
complaints.description: This is nothing short of daylight robbery and fraudulent billing! I booked consignment CN-1182940182 containing 2 cotton sofa cushions from Islamabad to Faisalabad. Dead weight on my scale was 1.2 kg, but your invoice charged me for 2.5 kg volumetric weight, extorting an extra PKR 180! You thieves are cheating ordinary citizens by inflating numbers! Adjust this bill right now or I will post this invoice on every Facebook consumer rights group!

expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Sentiment-urgency trap: Heated accusations of fraud and public shaming threats over a routine volumetric calculation discrepancy under PKR 1,000.

complaints.title: WHERE IS MY COD MONEY?! Bank holiday is NOT an excuse to hold merchant funds!
complaints.description: I run an apparel brand in Multan and our weekly COD remittance cycle was due on Wednesday for CN batch BTH-9941. It is now Thursday morning and the money has not hit our Meezan Bank account! Your accounts helpdesk said 'Wednesday was 12th Rabi-ul-Awwal bank holiday so funds release today'. I don't care about your public holidays! You are illegally holding PKR 65,000 of our working capital to earn bank interest! Disburse our funds in the next 30 minutes!

complaints.title: DAY 3 AND NO REFUND! You scammers are sitting on my PKR 3,500!
complaints.description: I returned order CN-5510293847 on Monday morning and your portal approved the return. Today is Thursday (day 3) and when I check my bank statement, my PKR 3,500 is still missing! Your chat bot keeps babbling that refunds take 5 to 7 working days. That is absolute rubbish! When I buy online money leaves instantly, but when you refund you hold it for days! Send my money right now or I will lodge an online cybercrime complaint!

complaints.title: LOCKED OUT OF MY ACCOUNT! Fix this immediately or I am suing RaftarXpress!
complaints.description: Your portal is a piece of garbage! I tried logging in this morning and after just trying my normal password 5 times it locked my account! Why do you lock people out of their own profile?! I have three packages arriving this week and I cannot see tracking! Unlock my account this second! If my deliveries fail because you locked me out, my attorney will serve legal notices on your Karachi headquarters!

complaints.description: Consignment CN-7729103948 departed Lahore linehaul center at 11:00 PM last night bound for Rawalpindi. It is now 9:00 AM and the tracking status is still stuck on 'In Transit - Linehaul Motorway'! Why has it not updated for 10 straight hours?! Did the driver steal my parcel or did the truck crash?! Your customer support agents on WhatsApp are useless robots repeating the same script! Give me an exact GPS location right now!

Remove my number from your marketing database immediately or I will file formal complaints with PTA and FIA Cybercrime!

complaints.title: HOW DARE THE RIDER GIVE MY PARCEL TO THE GATE GUARD AS I INSTRUCTED?!
complaints.description: I am writing this in pure disgust! Parcel CN-6610293819 arrived while I was in an executive zoom meeting. The rider phoned me and I specifically told him 'Leave it with the building gate security guard, I will collect it later'. But when I went downstairs 2 hours later to pick it up, the guard had placed it on the security reception table! How could the rider trust a building guard with my private parcel?! He should have waited outside my gate in person until my meeting ended! Fire him for reckless negligence!

Are your delivery riders illiterate or completely blind?! Why did he hand me yellow sheets?! Credit my bank account before close of business today or I will withdraw all my personal and corporate shipments!

The vehicle was recorded on our dashcam driving at approximately 80 km/h directly through an active elementary school crossing zone, narrowly avoiding two pedestrians on the zebra crossing. I have attached the video timestamp for your review. We kindly request that you review the vehicle telematics and advise your driver accordingly.

The delivery courier arrived at our factory gate and refused to surrender the prepaid consignment unless our receiving supervisor paid him PKR 10,000 cash, which he claimed was an unbilled 'heavy consignment surcharge'. Our production line remains halted pending these gaskets. We request that your operations supervisor intervene to secure release of our consignment.

complaints.title: Data protection inquiry regarding inadvertent receipt of 850 customer records

Attached to the message was an unencrypted CSV manifest containing full names, CNIC numbers, delivery addresses, and mobile numbers for 850 private consumers belonging to a competing merchant. We have quarantined the file on our secure servers and look forward to receiving your instructions regarding certified data destruction.

While we appreciate the historical cooperation with your sales team, persistent systemic delivery delays and unfulfilled SLA benchmarks across our nationwide retail branches have compelled our board of directors to transition our freight operations to an alternate carrier. We wish RaftarXpress continued success in its future endeavors.

complaints.title: Discrepancy notice regarding unauthorized bank account modification on merchant profile
complaints.description: Dear Billing and Security Team, Good afternoon. While reconciling our weekly COD disbursement statements this morning, our finance manager observed that the bank settlement account on our merchant profile (Merchant ID M-88192) was modified yesterday at 3:15 AM to an unfamiliar account at an off-branch in Rawalpindi. Consequently, yesterday's scheduled remittance of PKR 340,000 appears to have been routed to this newly added account rather than our corporate account at HBL Karachi. We recommend that your security team inspect the corporate freight authentication gateway for credential-stuffing activity.
